subject.title: feat(control-ui): selection popup with More details and Ask in side chat via /btw

question: Should the Control UI adopt this Codex-style text-selection toolbar as a first-party chat interaction?
rationale: This adds a new visible interaction pattern to the primary web chat, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human product acceptance even after mechanical defects are fixed.

options.title: Adopt the toolbar
options.body: Accept the interaction after the branch is rebased, attributable checks are fixed, and real behavior proof is attached.

options.title: Retain command-only `/btw`
options.body: Decline the new toolbar and keep side questions available only through the existing typed command.

recommendation.title: Adopt the toolbar
recommendation.body: Accept the interaction after the branch is rebased, attributable checks are fixed, and real behavior proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history shows ownership of both the current BTW card and the adjacent annotate-to-prompt interaction on this exact UI surface.
